completion_decisions: Register all six target roles: adaptive GA and gBest PSO, each operating on array, binary and continuous constraints.
Use the journal-authoritative 628-position binary profile for formal target experiments and retain the thesis 658-position version as a separately named profile.
Use 20 Bonus B76-2000 turbines, 175 m separation, 12 directions, one-metre-per-second speed bins, first-order G.C. Larsen wakes and RSS superposition.
Use pinned OpenWAKE as-built coordinates, B76 curves and public wind rose because the target SCADA and turbine arrays are not published.
Calibrate one fixed AEP factor at the target as-built 95.41 GWh and 93 percent availability anchor; never retune it per candidate layout.

Anchor the layout-independent lifetime cost at the paper's as-built value while preserving layout-dependent cable length, electrical loss and array-cable cost through a disclosed capacity-group MST surrogate.
Use the direct predecessor's roulette and uniform GA semantics, source adaptive probabilities, 20 percent elitism, and count both source-required child evaluation phases as physical FES.
Use a declared canonical stochastic gBest PSO completion because the target omits its tuned coefficients and prints an ambiguous velocity equation.
Report paper-literal 8766-hour and calendar 8760-hour AEP separately.
Use one run for every algorithm/mode role because thesis Section 8.6 explicitly states that every combination was executed once.
Use one persistent full-core C++ team, population-parallel fixed-index evaluation, frozen generation state, counter-keyed random events and ordered commits.

paper.authors: Ajit C. Pillai and John Chick and Mahdi Khorasanchi and Sami Barbouchi and Lars Johanning
paper.title: Application of an offshore wind farm layout optimization methodology at Middelgrunden wind farm

paper_source_conflicts: The target journal paper says the 100 m triangulation generated 628 allowable positions, whereas the later doctoral thesis says 658.
Target Eq.2 uses 8766 hours rather than the calendar value 8760.
The printed PSO equation and table omit tuned coefficient values and do not clearly expose canonical per-term stochastic multipliers.
The target cost and cable descriptions depend on proprietary industry inputs and Gurobi assets that are not published.
The phrase executed three times denotes three constraint modes, not three stochastic repeats; the thesis explicitly confirms single runs.

scope.claim_boundary: source-backed flexible academic reproduction of the complete Middelgrunden problem and all six native algorithm/constraint roles; not author source, proprietary model, unavailable site arrays, random state or exact numerical replay

constraints_and_repair.resolution: elongated 5.7 km2 declared site proxy, exactly 20 turbines and pairwise Euclidean spacing at least 175m; each encoding has a deterministic feasibility repair

decision_variables.resolution: array: six spacing/orientation/translation reals; binary: 628 journal-position values; continuous: 40 direct coordinates

encoding_and_decoder.resolution: regular rectilinear grid, target-count 100m triangular candidate grid, and direct coordinate decoders all feed one common evaluator

initialization.resolution: unique counter-keyed feasible populations distributed across each encoding search space

metrics_and_repeats.resolution: gross/net literal and calendar AEP, cable length/loss, lifetime cost, LCOE, spacing, layouts, FES, generations, convergence reason, timings, workers and hash; one run per native role

objective_and_direction.resolution: minimize discounted lifetime cost divided by discounted AEP

paper_native_cases.resolution: GA-array, GA-binary, GA-continuous, PSO-array, PSO-binary and PSO-continuous

parameters.resolution: population/swarm 100, maximum 1000 generations, adaptive GA, 20 percent elitism, dynamic PSO boundary handling, V-shaped binary transfer and global topology

stopping_and_physical_fes.resolution: diversity at most 10 percent, printed GA mean/best test, no improvement for 50 generations or maximum 1000; one full decoded LCOE evaluation is one physical FES and both GA child evaluations count

update_order.resolution: GA frozen-parent selection/crossover/evaluate/adaptive-mutate/evaluate/ordered elitist replacement; synchronous PSO move/evaluate then ordered personal/global-best commit

wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.resolution: first-order G.C. Larsen wake, upstream sequencing, RSS superposition, B76 curves, cable electrical loss and explicitly labelled capacity-group MST/cost surrogate anchored at the as-built cost

wind_and_scenario_sampling.resolution: 12 direction sectors and integer speeds 3 through 25m/s with fixed Weibull cell masses, literal 8766-hour integration and calendar audit

development_h6_20260731.work: all six paper-native GA/PSO by array/binary/continuous roles, population 100 and exactly five fixed generations per role
development_h6_20260731.comparison_boundary: same pure-C++ implementation with one versus twenty Spark workers; not MATLAB, OpenWAKE or author-code comparison

development_paper_parameter_preview_2026.claim_boundary: local functional preview using the explicitly reconstructed public proxy environment; not immutable Waffle formal evidence and not author numeric replay
